name: 手绘小人
author: TO DO
description: 手绘线条小人动作动画：先生成一组关键帧，再自动拼成动画。描述角色和动作即可，可逐帧写分镜。

inputs.label: 角色
inputs.placeholder: 例如：一个圆脑袋的火柴小人，戴红色围巾

inputs.label: 动作
inputs.placeholder: 例如：拿起水杯喝一口水，再把杯子放下

options.label: 马克笔
options.prompt: bold black marker outlines of even thickness, slightly wobbly hand-drawn lines

options.label: 铅笔
options.prompt: loose dark graphite pencil lines with a sketchy, slightly rough hand-drawn feel

options.label: 蜡笔
options.prompt: thick waxy crayon outlines with broken rough edges, childlike hand-drawn feel

options.label: 黑白线稿
options.prompt: Pure black line art only, no color fills

options.label: 局部点色
options.prompt: Mostly black line art with only one or two flat accent colors on key items (such as clothing or the held object)

options.label: 平涂上色
options.prompt: Simple flat color fills inside the outlines, a small cheerful palette, no gradients

options.label: 纯白底
options.prompt: Isolated on a pure flat white background, no ground shadow, no scenery, no paper texture

options.label: 白纸
options.prompt: On plain off-white sketchbook paper with a very subtle paper grain, no scenery

prompt.template: Hand-drawn 2D cartoon animation character: {{character}}, performing the action: {{action}}. Drawn with {{line}}. {{color}}. Simple, readable silhouette; the character design (proportions, clothes, colors, props) stays identical in every pose; full body visible, side or three-quarter view, like a key drawing from a hand-drawn animation. Flat 2D, no shading gradients, no photographic lighting. {{background}}.
